title: A refusal-healing durable retirement failure (authorization_unknown) holds the head for Resume though it is a local persistence fault
outcome: When retire_queued_engram_evaluation fails during Begin refusal healing (engram_host_adapter.rs:5484-5492 at be2ed177), for example because a persist fence missed its deadline under load, the card is authorization_unknown and the head is held for Resume. Classify the transient cases and re-admit them automatically, with a bound, rather than holding.
acceptance: A refusal-healing durable retirement failure (authorization_unknown) holds the head for Resume though it is a local persistence fault is done
